plan.title: Electron Shell + API Client + Login Page (Full Spec) + Page Stubs

task.description:
Initialize Electron Forge project with vite-typescript template in client/.
Steps: 1. Run `npx create-electron-app client --template=vite-typescript` (or scaffold manually if template layout differs). 2. Configure client/package.json: - name: "smart-copilot-client" - engines.node: ">=20" - Scripts: start, build, build:electron, build:web - Dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, lucide-react, motion (framer-motion v11 rebrand), @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, electron-store - DevDependencies: @types/react, @types/react-dom, typescript, vite, @electron-forge/cli, etc. 3. Configure client/tsconfig.json: - strict: true, noImplicitAny: true - paths: { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } - jsx: "react-jsx" 4. Configure client/vite.config.ts with path alias for @/. 5. Configure client/forge.config.ts for Vite plugin.
NO TypeScript `any` allowed (strict: true, noImplicitAny: true per enforcement rules).
task.verification: `cd client && pnpm install` succeeds. `cd client && pnpm run build` succeeds (or at least TypeScript compiles). tsconfig.json has "strict": true and "noImplicitAny": true. No `: any` in any TypeScript file.
task.done-condition: Electron Forge project initializes. TypeScript compiles in strict mode. All React + Radix + motion/react dependencies installed. Path alias @/ configured. forge.config.ts uses Vite plugin.

task.description:
Create Electron main process files: main.ts, windows.ts, ipc.ts, local-store.ts.
client/src/main/main.ts: - Create BrowserWindow, load renderer. - Apply theme before window renders (nativeTheme.themeSource from electron-store). - Register IPC handlers. - On ready: create main window.
client/src/main/windows.ts: - createMainWindow(): BrowserWindow config (width: 1200, height: 800, webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false }).
client/src/main/ipc.ts: - IPC handlers for safeStorage operations: - "auth:store-tokens": encrypt and store access + refresh tokens via safeStorage. - "auth:get-tokens": decrypt and return tokens. - "auth:clear-tokens": remove stored tokens. - Path traversal protection on any file-write IPC handlers.
client/src/main/local-store.ts: - electron-store instance with defaults per spec (obsidian.vaultPath, workspace.*, theme.*). - ESM import pattern.
client/src/main/preload.ts: - contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld("electronAPI", { ... }) for all IPC operations.
task.verification: No localStorage.setItem or sessionStorage.setItem in any file. safeStorage used for token encryption. contextIsolation: true and nodeIntegration: false in BrowserWindow config. electron-store defaults match spec. No `: any` in TypeScript.
task.done-condition: Electron main process creates a BrowserWindow with security best practices (contextIsolation, no nodeIntegration). safeStorage encrypts JWT tokens. electron-store manages non-secret settings. IPC handlers exposed via contextBridge preload. Theme applied before window renders.

task.description:
Create API client singleton and typed wrapper functions.
client/src/renderer/api/client.ts: - ApiClient class with baseUrl, accessToken management. - fetch<T>(path, options): generic typed fetch with auth header injection. - 401 handling: attempt token refresh, retry once. If refresh fails, redirect to login. - ApiError class with status and message. - Export singleton: apiClient.
client/src/renderer/api/auth.ts: - Typed wrapper functions for auth endpoints: - api.auth.login(username, password) -> TokenResponse - api.auth.register(username, email, password) -> TokenResponse - api.auth.me() -> UserResponse - api.auth.updateProfile(updates) -> UserResponse - api.auth.changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword) -> void - api.auth.refresh(refreshToken) -> TokenResponse - api.auth.sessions() -> SessionResponse[] - api.auth.revokeSession(sessionId) -> void - admin.createUser, admin.deleteUser, admin.listUsers, admin.resetPassword, admin.updateUser
client/src/renderer/api/index.ts: - Barrel export: re-export api object and apiClient.
client/src/renderer/api/generated/ — placeholder .gitkeep (codegen runs after backend is up).
Platform abstraction: client/src/platform/types.ts: PlatformAPI interface. client/src/platform/electron.ts: IPC-based implementations. client/src/platform/web.ts: browser-safe fallbacks/no-ops.
task.files: client/src/renderer/api/client.ts, client/src/renderer/api/auth.ts, client/src/renderer/api/index.ts, client/src/renderer/api/generated/.gitkeep, client/src/platform/types.ts, client/src/platform/electron.ts, client/src/platform/web.ts
task.verification: No `: any` in any TypeScript file. apiClient exported as singleton from client.ts. All auth wrapper functions defined. No localStorage/sessionStorage usage. Platform abstraction is at client/src/platform/ (NOT client/src/renderer/platform/). `ls client/src/platform/types.ts` succeeds. `grep "platform" client/vite.config.ts` confirms alias points to client/src/platform/ not renderer. Components only import from @/api (barrel), never from @/api/generated.
task.done-condition: API client singleton handles auth headers, 401 refresh, and typed error handling. Typed wrapper functions exist for all Phase 1 auth + admin endpoints. Platform abstraction provides Electron (IPC) and web (fallback) implementations. No `any` types. No web storage.

task.description:
Create the Login page at full design spec fidelity per ui-spec.md section 6.1.
client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx: - Full-screen split layout: left half (dark branding), right half (white form). - Left half (bg-[#0a0a0a] text-white): - Ambient radial gradients (secondary/20 top-left, blue-500/10 bottom-right, blur-[120px]). - Logo + wordmark. - Headline: "Your Intelligence, Amplified." (secondary accent on last word). - Three feature bullets with icon + title + description. - Footer: copyright, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service links. - Right half (bg-white): - Standard login: heading "Welcome back", sub "Please enter your details to sign in." - Email field (Mail icon prefix, bg-black/5 rounded-xl). - Password field (Lock icon prefix) + "Forgot?" link. - Submit button (bg-black text-white rounded-xl + ArrowRight icon with hover translate). - First-run variant (triggered by setup_required:true from GET /health): - Heading changes to "Create Admin Account". - Fields: username, email, password, confirm password. No "Forgot?" link. - Forced password change overlay: - Triggered by must_change_password:true in login response. - Heading: "Change Your Password", sub: "Your admin has required a password change." - New password + confirm password fields. "Set New Password" button. - Blocks all navigation until changed. - Animation: motion/react — form container scale 0.95->1, opacity 0->1. Feature bullets stagger.
CSS: Use CSS custom properties from design system spec (--sc-secondary, --sc-font-headline, etc.). Icons: Lucide React (Mail, Lock, ArrowRight). Import from motion/react (NOT framer-motion).
task.verification: LoginView.tsx renders split layout with dark left and white right. First-run variant shows "Create Admin Account" when setup_required=true. Forced password change overlay renders when must_change_password=true. Uses motion/react for animations (not framer-motion): `grep "from 'motion/react'" client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx` returns a match. Uses Lucide React icons (Mail, Lock, ArrowRight): `grep -E "Mail|Lock|ArrowRight" client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx` returns matches. Uses --sc-* CSS custom properties: `grep "\-\-sc-secondary" client/src/renderer/styles/tokens.css` returns a match. `grep "framer-motion" client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx` returns no matches (framer-motion must NOT be imported directly). No `: any` in TypeScript: `grep ": any" client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx` returns no matches. No localStorage/sessionStorage: `grep "localStorage\|sessionStorage" client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx` returns no matches. File is PascalCase.tsx: `ls client/src/renderer/views/LoginView.tsx` succeeds (not LoginView/index.tsx).
task.done-condition: Login page matches ui-spec.md section 6.1: split layout, dark branding panel, white form, first-run variant (admin bootstrap), forced password change overlay. Animations work via motion/react. All three form states (login, register, change-password) functional and wired to API client.

dimension.name: knowledge
dimension.rationale: Design spec translation, CSS custom properties

task.description:
Create React app shell with routing + nav rail + structural page stubs.
client/src/renderer/index.html: HTML entry point with Google Fonts import (Space Grotesk, Inter, Material Symbols). client/src/renderer/main.tsx: React 18 createRoot, render App. client/src/renderer/App.tsx: - React Router v6 with routes: - /login → LoginView - / → Home (DashboardView) - /workspace → WorkspaceView - /customize → CustomizeView - /history → ChatHistoryView - /settings → SettingsView (stub) - /admin → AdminView (stub) - Auth guard: if not authenticated, redirect to /login. - First-run detection: GET /health → setup_required → show register form on login. - AuthContext: manages isAuthenticated, user, tokens state.
Structural page stubs (correct route + shell + nav rail, placeholder body): - client/src/renderer/views/DashboardView.tsx: "Home" page with stat card placeholders. - client/src/renderer/views/WorkspaceView.tsx: 3-pane layout shell (left sidebar placeholder, chat placeholder, editor placeholder). - client/src/renderer/views/CustomizeView.tsx: "Customize" heading + tab bar placeholder. - client/src/renderer/views/ChatHistoryView.tsx: "Chat History" heading + list placeholder.
Navigation rail component: - client/src/renderer/components/NavRail.tsx: vertical icon nav with Lucide icons (Home, MessageSquare, Folder, SlidersHorizontal, History, Settings, LayoutDashboard for admin). - Active state highlighting. Routing via react-router-dom NavLink.
All component files: flat PascalCase.tsx. No ComponentName/index.tsx pattern.
task.verification: App renders with React Router. All 7 routes accessible. Nav rail appears on authenticated pages with correct icons. Unauthenticated users redirected to /login. All view files are PascalCase.tsx (no index.tsx pattern). No `: any` in TypeScript. No localStorage/sessionStorage. Google Fonts loaded in index.html. AuthContext provides isAuthenticated and user state.
task.done-condition: Electron app launches, shows login page. After login, nav rail appears with 7 routes. Each page stub renders correct heading and placeholder content. Auth guard redirects to /login when not authenticated. First-run detection works via /health. All files follow PascalCase.tsx naming.
